key.name: opacity
key.description: Background opacity of the panel islands (0 = fully transparent, 1 = solid).

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Corner radius of the panel islands in pixels.

key.name: margin
key.description: Gap around and between the panel islands in pixels.

key.name: panel-height
key.description: Height of the top panel in pixels. Increase if the clock or buttons look cramped.

key.name: island-color
key.description: Base color of the panel islands as a #rrggbb hex string. Combined with the opacity setting.

key.name: enable-shadow
key.description: Draw a soft shadow under the panel islands.
